proposition: Yazdī served as munshī to Ibrāhīm Sulṭān b. Shāhrukh, so the Munshaʾāt-i Yazdī contains letters to the Mamluk sultan and to Gulbarga written in a ruler's name, unlike the Munshaʾāt-i Turka; none of these is a letter by Ibn Turka.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
